steps: ICU; beta-blocker (propranolol) for adrenergic symptoms and to block T4→T3 conversion.
Antithyroid drug - propylthiouracil (preferred in storm) or carbimazole.
Give iodine (Lugol's/potassium iodide) at least 1 h AFTER the antithyroid drug.
Hydrocortisone (reduces T4→T3 and treats relative adrenal insufficiency).
Supportive: cooling, fluids, treat the precipitant (often infection); avoid aspirin.

confirm: Severe thyrotoxicosis with fever, tachyarrhythmia, agitation/delirium, GI/hepatic dysfunction (Burch-Wartofsky score). Treat clinically.
